description: Bornes de recharge véhicules électriques is a dataset listed in Open Data Hauts-de-Seine, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Rueil-Malmaison. Les bornes de recharge Autolib' mises à disposition des Rueillois Dans le cadre de cette mesure, les anciennes prises Autolib' seront remplacées par des prises T2S et leur puissance sera remontée à 7KW pour réduire le temps de charge complet qui sera d'environ 5h à 6h en fonction des modèles de voiture. Coverage: Hauts-de-Seine. The portal files it under Equipement / Services, Transport / Mobilité. Its keywords are bornes de recharge électrique, véhicule électrique, IRVE. The portal shows 19 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2020-05-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-hauts-de-seine-fr-portal.
